description: Get facts for a specific network interface or all network interfaces within a resource group.

parameters.name: ad_user
parameters.description: Active Directory username. Use when authenticating with an Active Directory user rather than service principal.

parameters.name: adfs_authority_url
parameters.description: Azure AD authority url. Use when authenticating with Username/password, and has your own ADFS authority.

parameters.name: api_profile
parameters.description: Selects an API profile to use when communicating with Azure services. Default value of latest is appropriate for public clouds; future values will allow use with Azure Stack. Default: "latest"

parameters.name: auth_source
parameters.description: Controls the source of the credentials to use for authentication. Can also be set via the ANSIBLE_AZURE_AUTH_SOURCE environment variable. When set to auto (the default) the precedence is module parameters -> env -> credential_file -> cli. When set to env, the credentials will be read from the environment variables When set to credential_file, it will read the profile from ~/.azure/credentials. When set to cli, the credentials will be sources from the Azure CLI profile. subscription_id or the environment variable AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID can be used to identify the subscription ID if more than one is present otherwise the default az cli subscription is used. When set to msi, the host machine must be an azure resource with an enabled MSI extension. subscription_id or the environment variable AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID can be used to identify the subscription ID if the resource is granted access to more than one subscription, otherwise the first subscription is chosen. The msi was added in Ansible 2.6. Choices: "auto" ← (default) "cli" "credential_file" "env" "msi"

parameters.name: cert_validation_mode
parameters.description: Controls the certificate validation behavior for Azure endpoints. By default, all modules will validate the server certificate, but when an HTTPS proxy is in use, or against Azure Stack, it may be necessary to disable this behavior by passing ignore. Can also be set via credential file profile or the AZURE_CERT_VALIDATION environment variable. Choices: "ignore" "validate"

parameters.name: client_id
parameters.description: Azure client ID. Use when authenticating with a Service Principal or Managed Identity (msi). Can also be set via the AZURE_CLIENT_ID environment variable.

parameters.name: cloud_environment
parameters.description: For cloud environments other than the US public cloud, the environment name (as defined by Azure Python SDK, eg, AzureChinaCloud, AzureUSGovernment), or a metadata discovery endpoint URL (required for Azure Stack). Can also be set via credential file profile or the AZURE_CLOUD_ENVIRONMENT environment variable. Default: "AzureCloud"

parameters.name: disable_instance_discovery
parameters.description: Determines whether or not instance discovery is performed when attempting to authenticate. Setting this to true will completely disable both instance discovery and authority validation. This functionality is intended for use in scenarios where the metadata endpoint cannot be reached such as in private clouds or Azure Stack. The process of instance discovery entails retrieving authority metadata from https://login.microsoft.com/ to validate the authority. By setting this to **True**, the validation of the authority is disabled. As a result, it is crucial to ensure that the configured authority host is valid and trustworthy. Set via credential file profile or the AZURE_DISABLE_INSTANCE_DISCOVERY environment variable. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: log_mode
parameters.description: Parent argument.

parameters.name: log_path
parameters.description: Parent argument.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Only show results for a specific network interface.

parameters.name: password
parameters.description: Active Directory user password. Use when authenticating with an Active Directory user rather than service principal.

parameters.name: profile
parameters.description: Security profile found in ~/.azure/credentials file.

parameters.name: resource_group
parameters.description: Name of the resource group containing the network interface(s). Required when searching by name.

parameters.name: secret
parameters.description: Azure client secret. Use when authenticating with a Service Principal.

parameters.name: subscription_id
parameters.description: Your Azure subscription Id.

parameters.name: tags
parameters.description: Limit results by providing a list of tags. Format tags as ‘key’ or ‘key:value’.

parameters.name: tenant
parameters.description: Azure tenant ID. Use when authenticating with a Service Principal.

parameters.name: thumbprint
parameters.description: The thumbprint of the private key specified in x509_certificate_path. Use when authenticating with a Service Principal. Required if x509_certificate_path is defined.

parameters.name: x509_certificate_path
parameters.description: Path to the X509 certificate used to create the service principal in PEM format. The certificate must be appended to the private key. Use when authenticating with a Service Principal.

examples:
- name: Get facts for one network interface
  azure_rm_networkinterface_info:
    resource_group: myResourceGroup
    name: nic001

- name: Get network interfaces within a resource group
  azure_rm_networkinterface_info:
    resource_group: myResourceGroup

- name: Get network interfaces by tag
  azure_rm_networkinterface_info:
    resource_group: myResourceGroup
    tags:
      - testing
      - foo:bar

return_values.name: networkinterfaces
return_values.description: List of network interface dicts. Each dict contains parameters can be passed to azure.azcollection.azure_rm_networkinterface module. Returned: always

return_values.name: create_with_security_group
return_values.description: Specifies whether a default security group should be be created with the NIC. Only applies when creating a new NIC. Returned: always Sample: false

return_values.name: dns_servers
return_values.description: Which DNS servers should the NIC lookup. List of IP addresses. Returned: always Sample: []

return_values.name: dns_settings
return_values.description: The DNS settings in network interface. Returned: always

return_values.name: applied_dns_servers
return_values.description: If the VM that uses this NIC is part of an Availability Set, then this list will have the union of all DNS servers from all NICs that are part of the Availability Set. This property is what is configured on each of those VMs. Returned: always Sample: []

return_values.name: internal_dns_name_label
return_values.description: Relative DNS name for this NIC used for internal communications between VMs in the same virtual network. Returned: always

return_values.name: internal_fqdn
return_values.description: Fully qualified DNS name supporting internal communications between VMs in the same virtual network. Returned: always

return_values.name: enable_accelerated_networking
return_values.description: Specifies whether the network interface should be created with the accelerated networking feature or not. Returned: always Sample: false

return_values.name: enable_ip_forwarding
return_values.description: Whether to enable IP forwarding Returned: always Sample: false

return_values.name: id
return_values.description: Id of the network interface. Returned: always Sample: "/subscriptions/xxxx-xxxxx/resourceGroups/testRG/providers/Microsoft.Network/networkInterfaces/nic01"

return_values.name: ip_configurations
return_values.description: List of IP configurations, if contains multiple configurations. Returned: always

return_values.name: application_gateway_backend_address_pools
return_values.description: List of existing application gateway backend address pools associated with the network interface. Returned: always

return_values.name: application_security_groups
return_values.description: List of Application security groups. Returned: always Sample: ["/subscriptions/<subsid>/resourceGroups/<rg>/providers/Microsoft.Network/applicationSecurityGroups/myASG"]

return_values.name: load_balancer_backend_address_pools
return_values.description: List of existing load-balancer backend address pools associated with the network interface. Returned: always

return_values.name: name
return_values.description: Name of the IP configuration. Returned: always Sample: "default"

return_values.name: primary
return_values.description: Whether the IP configuration is the primary one in the list. Returned: always Sample: true

return_values.name: private_ip_address
return_values.description: Private IP address for the IP configuration. Returned: always Sample: "10.10.0.4"

return_values.name: private_ip_allocation_method
return_values.description: Private IP allocation method. Returned: always Sample: "Dynamic"

return_values.name: public_ip_address
return_values.description: Name of the public IP address. None for disable IP address. Returned: always

return_values.name: public_ip_allocation_method
return_values.description: Public IP allocation method. Returned: always

return_values.name: location
return_values.description: Azure location. Returned: always Sample: "eastus"

return_values.name: mac_address
return_values.description: The MAC address of the network interface. Returned: always

return_values.name: provisioning_state
return_values.description: The provisioning state of the network interface. Returned: always Sample: "Succeeded"

return_values.name: resource_group
return_values.description: Name of a resource group where the network interface exists. Returned: always Sample: "testRG"

return_values.name: security_group
return_values.description: A security group resource ID with which to associate the network interface. Returned: always

return_values.name: subnet
return_values.description: Name of an existing subnet within the specified virtual network. Returned: always Sample: "sub01"

return_values.name: tags
return_values.description: Tags of the network interface. Returned: always Sample: {"key1": "value1", "key2": "value2"}

return_values.name: virtual_network
return_values.description: An existing virtual network with which the network interface will be associated. It is a dict which contains name and resource_group of the virtual network. Returned: always

return_values.name: resource_gorup
return_values.description: Resource groups name that exist on the virtual network. Returned: always Sample: "testRG"

return_values.name: subnet_id
return_values.description: The subnet’s ID. Returned: always Sample: "/subscriptions/xxx-xxxx/resourceGroups/testRG/providers/Microsoft.Network/virtualNetworks/nic01/subnets/sub01"

return_values.name: subscription_id
return_values.description: Virtual network Subscription ID. Returned: always Sample: "xxxxxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxxx"
